lead: A feature named `target` has a proof directory git ignores, and nothing on the machine that wrote it can tell.
body: `.gitignore`'s `**/target` is for cargo's output and matches `docs/examples/**/target/` and `tests/hostile/**/target/` as well, while `bun nv proofs` reads the disk and sees every file. `.gitignore` re-includes those two trees; for a new tree that is attributed by path, check `git status --short --ignored <tree>` once.
